items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Muhammad Ali you know, he had Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, that was spiritual you know

ctx.x: When I read about your music from the 70s especially, whoever is writing it, I don’t know if it’s you or over the years management, they mention spiritual jazz, spiritual music. And I’d like to know if that’s the way you thought of it yourself. Did you think of it as spiritual and was that part of your direction?

Well that was the trend going then you know. Because the Civil Rights Movement was in full swing you know. And there was Martin Luther King, Reverend Doctor Martin Luther King. He was a preacher. That’s spiritual you know. Muhammad Ali you know, he had Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, that was spiritual you know, and then we had what else did we have, Coltrane.
